name: Cross Specialization (Combat)
body:
You are versatile in your abilities.

Prerequisite(s): 11th level vigilante.

Benefit(s): You are treated as though you possessed either the avenger or stalker specialization for the purposes of which vigilante talents you can select, treating your character level as your vigilante level -4 when selecting vigilante talents with this feat, but for the purpose of the vigilante talents effect, your effective vigilante level is equal to your full character level.

Normal: You must select the avenger or stalker vigilante specialization to select talent which require the stated specialization.
